classification.difficultyReason: Rearrange the space-diagonal formula with two equal unknown edge dimensions.

content.prompt: Find the value of $x$ in the figure below:

spec.sourceRegion: Exercise 11C, question 4, bottom of left column
spec.description: Unfilled rectangular prism beneath the stem. Retains 7 cm front edge, two x cm dimensions and the red space diagonal labelled 9 cm. Hidden edges are dashed.
spec.mathematics: The prism has mutually perpendicular edge dimensions 7, x and x cm, and a space diagonal of 9 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: The two unknown dimensions remain labelled x cm; no value of x appears.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}9^2 &= 7^2+x^2+x^2\\81 &= 49+2x^2\\2x^2 &= 32\\x^2 &= 16\\x &= 4\end{align*}$$

The unknown edges are each $4\text{ cm}$.
